## Upgrade notes

`up serve` and `up tui` now use `~/.config/up/up.db` by default instead of `./up.db`. Pass `--db PATH` to keep using another file.

If you installed v0.1.0 with `--service`, it is a system service with its own database. To move to the new setup:

```sh
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/giulianotesta7/up/v0.2.0/install.sh | sh -s -- --uninstall
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/giulianotesta7/up/v0.2.0/install.sh | sh -s -- --service
```

Uninstalling keeps `/var/lib/up/up.db` and prints the command to copy it to `~/.config/up/up.db` if you want to keep your monitors.

## Features

- **One default database:** `up serve` and `up tui` open the same file without flags, so the TUI always shows what the daemon is checking. The directory is created on first use.
- **User service:** `install.sh --service` now installs a systemd user service that runs as you, with no root and no extra `up` user. It also enables `loginctl enable-linger` so it keeps running after you log out.
- **Cleaner uninstall:** `--uninstall` removes both the user service and a legacy v0.1.0 system service, and always keeps your database.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/giulianotesta7/up/compare/v0.1.0...v0.2.0

[Documentation](https://github.com/giulianotesta7/up/blob/v0.2.0/README.md)
